text: Two-column layout: notes list on left, selected note editor on right
Each note has a title, body text, and created date
Notes persist across page reloads using localStorage
When 50 notes exceeded, the oldest note by created date is automatically dropped
New Note dialog validates that title is not empty
Inline error shown under the title field when title is empty
New Note dialog closes when Escape key is pressed
Empty state displayed when there are no notes
